swing_ideas.text:
Clean daily bull flag with the potential to breakout to a prior resistance around 189. Aligns nicely with a measured move target also. Strong uptrend behind the name.

IP – Daily / monthly chart
Great looking hook on the daily into a known resistance... yeah, a multi decade resistance. Can it get up and out of this monthly inverted head and shoulders? The all time high is technically at 63.38.
Double bottom after the earnings panic. Not the best looking bar on Friday, but over the neckline. If price can maintain over 106, looking for some further retracement to the upside.
Another double bottom, after some earnings panic. If price can get more confident daily closes over 126.5 looking for a rotation back towards the trend line.

sections: S&P weekly chart – The beauty of simplicity. Prior resistance, turns support.

Market internals – Bulls win at the exchange level when the market broke out of balance on Thursday / Friday sessions. No stronger sellers to be found.
Market profile – Value moved higher on Thursday and Friday breakout sessions as well, indicating price acceptance rather than rejection on the move. Note the extremely poor high from Friday!
